longDescription: A twin-map toolkit for product designers. The story map structures a raw requirement into seven fields, splits the solution into a journey backbone, and grounds each feature in Who/What/When/Why/DoD with priority tiers and release swimlanes. The journey map maps one persona in one scenario: per-stage actions, touchpoints, thoughts, emotion, pain points and opportunities, with fact/hypothesis labels, an emotion curve and key moments. Journey opportunities import as story-map feature drafts.
tryPrompts: Map out a raw requirement into a user story map
Analyze this persona's user journey in this scenario
Import journey-map opportunities into the story map
